_comment: Worked example: the REAL slice spec for website-editor v3 Phase 11b-2, which shipped as
PR #883. Kept as documentation and as the fixture the wave deriver is checked against.
On the live run the wave grouping was done BY HAND (S1+S2+S3+S9 / S4, then S5+S6 / S7+S8)
and one agent still had to break file discipline. Feeding this spec to deriveWaves()
reproduces that grouping mechanically from ownedFiles alone — which is the point: the
grouping stops being a judgement call.
Note S7 declares public-community-reader.ts even though S4 owns it too. They are at
different dependency levels, so S7's edit lands after S4's merge. The skill's validation
step flags same-file-across-levels; here it is deliberate and append-only, and it is the
one case worth a human's eye before running.
prBody: See the plan. Middleware slug preservation, slug→page resolution with 308s, nav, per-page metadata, plus three pre-existing metadata-route bugs.

slices.title: single-source the protected/reserved segment lists
slices.scope: Move PROTECTED_PATH_PREFIXES into public-host-routes.ts and derive PROTECTED_FIRST_SEGMENTS from it. The two hand lists had already diverged (/welcome was protected but not reserved), and this branch runs above isProtectedPath, so a page slugged `welcome` would hijack a resident route.

slices.title: metadata + public-suffix passthrough on custom domains
slices.scope: isPublicSitePath('/sitemap.xml') is true, so the host-precedence block rewrites sitemap/robots to /public-site/… → 404. Add METADATA_FIRST_SEGMENTS; set headers and fall through instead.

slices.title: subdomain path-preserving public rewrite
slices.scope: The subdomain branch only runs for pathname === '/' and discards the path. Add a branch above isProtectedPath guarded by isReservedPublicSlug. Never read the DB to route.

slices.title: stale comments and a dangling reference
slices.scope: Delete the doc reference to isCommunityPublicOnlyHost (never written) and fix the comment claiming authenticated users are redirected to /dashboard (removed in 11b-0).

slices.title: public reader: slug, redirect, nav
slices.scope: Add getPageBySlug, resolveRedirect, listNavPages to the anon-safe reader. No delete_staged_at filter (D8). Never reach site-pages-service.ts — listSitePages locks and can INSERT.

slices.title: slug resolution, 308, 404, preview, per-page metadata
slices.scope: Replace notFound() on any slug with resolution + 308 redirects. generateMetadata gains params. Home must stay byte-identical.

slices.title: nav in the header and all four render sites
slices.scope: Optional nav prop following the footer? precedent. Suppress below 2 pages. No client island — the route is at 635 of a 700 KiB budget.

slices.title: sitemap.ts rootDomain + custom_domain + per-page entries
slices.scope: resolveCommunityContext is called without rootDomain, which makes source:'custom_domain' unreachable. The test mocks it wholesale, so a case MUST assert the argument or the fix is untested by construction.

slices.title: robots.ts rootDomain + custom_domain + allow /
slices.scope: Same rootDomain fix. Replace the fixed four-path allow-list with allow '/'. Do NOT add a Disallow for the indexing opt-out — a Disallow prevents the crawler ever reading noindex.

verifyCommands.expect: 0 failed; the DB-gated files actually execute
exit 0; no node:* in a client bundle

spotChecks.expect: a rootDomain argument assertion in EACH (S7/S8)
present as a column only, never as a filter (D8)
